g.text: LRU insertion: evict the tail from the list AND both maps
Capacity 3. This sequence follows the project code, which trims before registering the new key.
1. Link new node N_D; size becomes 4
D has no map entry yet. Old tail N_B exceeds capacity.
2. Detach N_B; use reverse_lookup[N_B] to get key B
Delete lookup[B] AND reverse_lookup[N_B]. Size returns to 3.
3. Register lookup[D] = N_D and reverse_lookup[N_D] = D
Final order: D, A, C. A later get(B) misses and leaves this order unchanged.
